name: InstantCampaign Spark
author: Cloud First Consulting
description: Live email and website analytics from your InstantCampaign workspace in the Omarchy bar: sends, open and click rates with their trend, recent campaigns, sending-domain health and warm-up, and website traffic. Read-only, over the InstantCampaign MCP endpoint with an API key you keep in a file only you can read.

barWidget.description: One envelope in the bar, lit when a sending domain needs attention, and a panel with the last week's email and web numbers.

schema.label: Period
schema.description: How many days the numbers cover. Each period is compared with the one before it.

schema.label: InstantCampaign URL
schema.description: Only change this for a self-hosted InstantCampaign.
